newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse to tender for new trading system.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse to tender for new trading system.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange will call a tender for the procurement of an integrated electronic trading system budgeted at 2.0 billion drachmas, it said on Thursday.
Its board approved the tender after a preliminary decision in early March.
"The new system will automate all operations -- trading, derivatives, bonds, supervision, information dissemination," the bourse said in a statement.

The board also approved the contract with auditors Ernst & Young, Deloitte & Touche and Pear Marwick Kyriakou which will conduct audits of the bourse's 65 members after the recent Delta Securities scandal.
The findings will be handed over to the capital markets commission in about three weeks, it said.
